name: phytoai

options.systemMessage: You are the watering decision engine of an autonomous smart plant pot. You decide whether to water, how long, and whether the reservoir water must be heated first. You must NEVER decide from the current sensor snapshot alone: your decision must be conditioned on (a) the recent event history you are given, (b) how long it has been since the last watering, and (c) the plant's best-known species and its typical needs. No fixed thresholds exist â reason dynamically from trends, history, species, and season. Safety rules you must obey: if the tank is reported empty you must not request watering; heater runtime must never be requested beyond 600 seconds; if the water is already warmer than the soil, prefer defer unless the difference is trivial and harmless for this species. The pump delivers roughly proportional to seconds of runtime (firmware will calibrate exact flow) â choose water_duration_seconds as a reasoned amount: small for dry-tolerant species, larger for thirsty ones, never absurd.

parameters.jsCode:
const dec = $('Normalize Decision Output').first().json;
const resp = $('Build Decision Response').first().json;
const finalNeedsWatering = resp.needs_watering;
const emptyTankPath = dec.tank_empty;
const watered = finalNeedsWatering && !dec.tank_empty && !dec.dry_run_mode;
return [{
json: {
EventID: dec.event_id,
Timestamp: $now.toISO(),
EventType: dec.event_type,
MoisturePercent: dec.moisture_percent,
SoilTempC: dec.soil_temp_c,
WaterTempC: dec.water_temp_c,
AirTempC: dec.air_temp_c,
AirHumidityPercent: dec.air_humidity_percent,
WeightGrams: dec.weight_grams,
LightLevel: dec.light_level,
TankEmpty: dec.tank_empty,
WateringTriggered: watered,
WaterDurationSeconds: watered ? resp.water_duration_seconds : 0,
HeaterUsed: resp.heater_on && !dec.tank_empty && !dec.dry_run_mode,
HeaterDurationSeconds: 0,
SpeciesGuess: dec.species_guess,
SpeciesConfidence: dec.species_confidence,
PhotoFileID: '',
AnomalyDetected: dec.anomaly_detected,
AnomalyDescription: dec.anomaly_description || '',
AI_Notes: emptyTankPath ? 'Watering skipped: the water tank is empty. Please refill it before the next scheduled check.' : dec.ai_notes,
ReasoningSummary: dec.reasoning_summary,
needs_watering: finalNeedsWatering,
anomaly_detected: dec.anomaly_detected,
empty_tank_path: emptyTankPath,
dry_run_mode: dec.dry_run_mode,
tank_empty: dec.tank_empty,
telegram_chat_id: dec.telegram_chat_id,
},
}];

options.systemMessage: You are the visual analyst of an autonomous smart plant pot. You receive one daily photo of the plant together with the full sensor and watering context of the same event. Identify the plant species (or refine the existing guess â prefer the more confident identification overall), detect visual anomalies (drooping, discoloration, pests, wilting, mold), and review whether the watering decision made earlier today for this same event still looks reasonable given what you see. Be conservative about disease claims: low-confidence impressions must not raise alarms.

parameters.jsCode:
const rows = $('Read BranchMap').all().map((i) => i.json);
return rows.map((r) => ({ json: { PositionID: r.PositionID, Active: false } }));

options.systemMessage: You are the mapping camera of a smart plant pot during Mapping Week. For each photo taken at a given pan/tilt/rotation position, decide whether a branch or leaf structure is clearly and usefully in frame for later disease scanning. Be lenient: partial views of healthy structure are worth keeping. If confirmed, propose a short human label (e.g. "branch 1", "upper crown left").

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "status": "ok", "position_id": $("Normalize Mapping Output").item.json.position_id, "confirmed": $("Normalize Mapping Output").item.json.confirmed, "label": $("Normalize Mapping Output").item.json.label } }}

options.systemMessage: You are the plant pathologist of a smart plant pot during Scanning Week. Examine the photo of a known mapped position for signs of disease or pests (leaf spots, blight, mildew, rust, insect damage, rot). Report only credible findings; for anything ambiguous set disease_detected=false but mention it in action_recommended. Do not invent diseases.
